package com.mukasanches.zapptv.vod

data class VodSubtitle(
    val uri: String,
    val language: String = "und",
    val label: String = "Legenda",
    val mimeType: String,
    val isDefault: Boolean = false
)

enum class RightsStatus {
    PUBLIC_DOMAIN,
    OPEN_LICENSE,
    ATTRIBUTION_REQUIRED,
    UNKNOWN,
    RESTRICTED
}

data class VodItem(
    val id: String,
    val title: String,
    val overview: String = "",
    val posterUrl: String? = null,
    val backdropUrl: String? = null,
    val year: String? = null,
    val genres: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val language: String = "und",
    val playbackUrl: String? = null,
    val source: String = "",
    val catalog: String = "",
    val detailUrl: String? = null,
    val licenseName: String? = null,
    val licenseUrl: String? = null,
    val attribution: String? = null,
    val subtitleLookupKey: String? = null,
    val subtitles: List<VodSubtitle> = emptyList(),
    val rightsStatus: RightsStatus = RightsStatus.UNKNOWN,
    val providers: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val alternatePlaybackUrls: List<String> = emptyList(),
    val externalIds: Map<String, String> = emptyMap(),
    val durationSeconds: Long? = null,
    val kind: Kind = Kind.MOVIE
) {
    enum class Kind { MOVIE, SERIES, EPISODE }

    val playable: Boolean
        get() = !playbackUrl.isNullOrBlank()
}

data class VodCatalogState(
    val featured: List<VodItem> = emptyList(),
    val movies: List<VodItem> = emptyList(),
    val series: List<VodItem> = emptyList(),
    val continueWatching: List<VodItem> = emptyList(),
    val page: Int = 1,
    val canLoadMore: Boolean = true,
    val status: String = "Catálogo de cinema pronto",
    val indexedCount: Int = 0,
    val playableCount: Int = 0,
    val portugueseSubtitleCount: Int = 0,
    val providerCount: Int = 0
)
